Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, where Driver 2 was stopped in the right lane of a
two-lane road when the front of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear bumper. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee after
the impact and was evaluated at the scene. The injury described is consistent with the force and direction of a
collision of this type. Driver 2 stated that the crash happened as Driver 1 described, and two witnesses who were
nearby gave statements that matched both drivers' accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show rear damage to
Driver 2's vehicle and front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and the extent of the damage is largely in line with the
impact described. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle and was identified as such by both drivers and the
witnesses. Nothing observed at the scene or reported by the parties indicated prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1
sttaed that they live at the same residence as the policyholder of the vehicle they were driving. No citations were
issued at the scene, and both vehicles were towed from the roadway.
</page>
